content:
incident-bot: Pager: P1 — elevated generation latency and 5xx in eu-west-1 for model fastgen-v2. Alert window: last 3m.
incident-bot: Symptoms: p50 ~900ms, p95 ~2.3s, 5xx rate ~12%.
oncall-alice: Taking this — paging eng-sre-bob and eng-runtime-clara.
oncall-alice: Handing off on-call. I'll coordinate comms.
eng-sre-bob: On it. pulling logs/traces now.
eng-runtime-clara: Checking worker saturation, queue lengths, and KV cache hit rates.
oncall-alice: Quick ask: draft initial status update so comms can publish ASAP once we agree on impact.
comms-joe: Will draft. Need clear impact scope (region, models, user-facing symptoms).
product-liz: Also confirm whether embeddings or only generation endpoints. Customers will ask.
eng-sre-bob: Looks isolated to generation endpoints for model fastgen-v2 in eu-west-1. Embeddings unaffected.
eng-sre-bob: Immediate mitigation plan: scale the autoscale pool by +40% and add a traffic route to fastgen-v1 as fallback.
oncall-alice: Initiating scaling + routing.
incident-bot: Deploybot: autoscale pool increased by 40% at 12:07 UTC.
eng-runtime-clara: Routing rule updated: 15% of traffic to fastgen-v1 canary fallback.
comms-joe: Draft initial statuspage copy below — quick check and approval please:
```text
We are investigating increased generation latency in eu-west-1 affecting some API requests for fastgen-v2. Impact: elevated response times and an increase in intermittent errors (5xx). Mitigation: we are scaling serving capacity and routing a subset of traffic to a fallback model. We will provide updates as we learn more; next update in 30 minutes.
```
legal-sue: Fine. Avoid explicit SLA/credit promises in initial notice.
product-liz: Add note: mostly observed for long-context requests (>4k tokens).
comms-joe: Updated copy with long-context note.
comms-joe: Publishing initial update now.
incident-bot: Statuspage: initial update published at 12:14 UTC.
eng-sre-bob: Monitoring metrics — p95 improving from 2.3s -> 1.1s within 10m. 5xx trending down.
oncall-alice: We'll post a periodic update at 12:40 unless there's a material change.
(20 minutes later)
eng-sre-bob: p95 stable ~700ms, 5xx down to 1.2%. Autoscale holding.
comms-joe: Draft periodic update:
```text
Update: Mitigations are having the intended effect. We scaled capacity and routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model. Response times are improving; a small percentage of long-context requests may still see elevated latency or errors. We continue to monitor. Next update in 30 minutes or as conditions change.
```
product-liz: Recording incident window for postmortem: start 12:06 UTC (pager), mitigation engaged 12:07 UTC, partial recovery observed 12:34 UTC.
oncall-alice: Also tagging owners for review.
comms-joe: Publishing periodic update.
incident-bot: Statuspage: update published at 12:40 UTC.
eng-sre-bob: Running resolve checklist: warm caches, validate autoscale stability, confirm no throttles.
eng-runtime-clara: KV cache warmed, no backlog on genqueue.
oncall-alice: Will hold pager open for a steady-state confirmation period (30m).
(30 minutes later)
eng-sre-bob: Metrics steady, 5xx back to baseline.
comms-joe: Proposed resolved notice:
```text
Resolved: The generation latency incident in eu-west-1 is resolved. Root cause: transient worker saturation on fastgen-v2 triggered by a spike in long-context requests. Mitigations: scaled serving capacity, routed a portion of traffic to a fallback model (fastgen-v1), and warmed caches. No customer action required. Incident window: 12:06 — 13:12 UTC.
```
product-liz: Add postmortem owners: @eng-sre-bob, @eng-runtime-clara.
legal-sue: Approved.
oncall-alice: Publishing resolved notice now and will open a postmortem doc.
incident-bot: Statuspage: resolved notice published at 13:15 UTC.
comms-joe: Preparing customer notification draft for account teams to share with affected customers.
eng-sre-bob: Drafting timeline + initial RCA for postmortem. Will include telemetry and mitigation steps.
oncall-alice: Closing pager — will attach postmortem link here when ready. :white_check_mark:
__notes: This thread is a single Slack conversation representing initial pager, mitigation actions, statuspage updates, and resolved notice. Messages are ordered chronologically and use realistic Slack shorthand, @mentions, and small code blocks for copy snippets.
